**My pick: Soundcore Space One (about $100, possibly about $80 with a code)**

- [Buy at Soundcore's US store](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one). This is an affiliate link from the deal site Dealectric.
- Best Products named it its top pick under $100. It praises the adaptive ANC, balanced sound, comfortable rotating ear cups and a good companion app ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)).
- Specs: 55 hours of battery with ANC off and 40 hours with it on, multipoint Bluetooth, and LDAC on Android ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-space-one)).
- Dealectric says code AFSC20 took $19.99 off the $99.99 price in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, and that it expires 2026-12-31. Prices change, so confirm at checkout.
- Downsides: it's heavier than rivals and has no sweat resistance, so it's not for workouts. LDAC doesn't work while connected to two devices.

**Other good options**

- **Anker Soundcore Space Q45 (around $100):** RTINGS' best budget ANC pick, with excellent noise isolation that quiets engine rumble and chatty coworkers. RTINGS measured 28 hours of battery, while CartIQ claims 50, so I'd trust the lab test. Some owners report the headband cracking ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)).
- **Anker Soundcore Life Q30 (under $100):** RTINGS' top over-ear under $100, with good ANC against engines and chatter and about 44 hours of battery. It leaks sound, so people nearby may hear your music ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)).
- **Anker Soundcore Life Q20 (2024) (cheaper):** Nearly matches the Q45's noise isolation, with 49 hours of battery. The build is plasticky and the earpads can flake ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)).
- **Sony WH-CH720N ($99):** Very light at 192g, but it only supports SBC and AAC, with no LDAC ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)).
- **Edifier Atom Max (about $45):** The best-value pick for tight budgets. Best Products says its hybrid ANC cuts up to 44dB. It has no 3.5mm jack ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)).
- **1MORE SonoFlow SE (about $65):** CartIQ lists 70 hours of battery but weaker ANC ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)).

The search results didn't include direct store links for these, so use the buy buttons on the linked pages. I'd skip the JBL Tune 760NC if ANC strength matters most, since RTINGS calls its ANC mediocre.
